_comment: The panel's HSI section (admin-hsi.js): synced share, the conflicts table the automatic resolver could not close, and the auto-resolved log. Serves BOTH shells: /admin#hsi and the direct /admin/hsi screen. Keys mirror locales/es/admin.hsi.json exactly.
admin.hsi.title: HSI synchronization
admin.hsi.hero_synced: of the upcoming approved appointments are scheduled in HSI
admin.hsi.hero_none: There are no upcoming appointments to synchronize with HSI.
admin.hsi.no_conflicts: No conflicts need a person: everything else resolves itself.
admin.hsi.confirm_reject: Reject the request? The patient is notified by email.
admin.hsi.err_hsi_disabled: This environment does not send appointments to HSI.
admin.hsi.err_hsi_unavailable: HSI is not responding right now.
admin.hsi.load_error: Could not load the HSI synchronization.
admin.hsi.sync_dni_copiado: DNI {dni} copied: paste it into HSI.
admin.hsi.sync_instalar: Install HSI Humanizador to load it with one tap
admin.hsi.instalar_link: Load appointments into HSI with one tap
admin.hsi.instalar_que: HSI Humanizador is a Chrome extension. Next to each appointment it adds «Cargar en HSI»: one tap fills HSI's «Nuevo turno» in your tab, and you check it and press Confirmar.
admin.hsi.instalar_paso_hsi: Open HSI in another Chrome tab, signed in with your user.
admin.hsi.instalar_paso_recargar: Reload this page: «Cargar en HSI» shows next to each appointment.
